title: Post-mortem identification of lithium plating in high energy automotive batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5342-5353
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00509D, Paper

Syed Muhammad Abbas, Anna Jodlbauer, Martin Wilkening, Helmar Wiltsche, Josef V. Ecker, Christian Ellersdorfer, Gregor Gstrein, Ilie Hanzu
The performance of LIBs deteriorates over time due to various aging mechanisms, among which lithium plating (LP) is critical. The goal of this research was to analytically approve the presence of LP, prior identified by non-destructive methods.
